title: Fake Part-Time Payroll
scenario: A new employer sends a cheque and asks you to return the overpayment.

answers.A: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.B: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.C: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.
answers.D: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.

explanation: Fake Part-Time Payroll: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Cheque overpayment is a classic job scam.
